difficulty_reason: The lemma states that under the hypotheses of the companion proposition the pullback and pushforward extend to an adjoint pair on sheaves and presheaves of algebraic structures, compatibly with the underlying sheaves of sets (statement lines 10610-10621). The proof is a complete argument: the filteredness of the colimits defining the left Kan extension lets those colimits define a functor on presheaves of algebraic structures (proof lines 10624-10630); adjointness is obtained by the same argument as for the corresponding statement on presheaves of sets (proof lines 10631-10632); and the pullback on sheaves is defined by sheafification, which also gives the compatibility with underlying sets (proof lines 10633-10635). The non-formal content is the reduction of the definitions to the set-based case. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
